subject: a vast wall of dark seawater towering hundreds of feet high on both sides of a dry seabed corridor at dusk, a lone robed figure with a staff raised standing small at the mouth of the parted sea, the water held back like glass cliffs glowing with deep teal and gold light, a desperate crowd streaming into the passage behind him, photoreal cinematic biblical epic, deep blue-green and gold jewel tones, the towering water and figure filling the right two-thirds, the left third dark and open for the headline text
title: THE SEA SPLIT OPEN
subtitle: and a nation walked through
